<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="uz"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Xasanov Sardor — Targetolog va Kontent-meyker</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#111413;--bg2:#1b201e;--ac:#8dff3f;--tx:#f4f6f2;--mu:#9aa39d;--ink:#0b0d0c;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
section{padding:44px 18px;max-width:640px;margin:auto}
h2{font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:8px}h2 em{font-style:normal;background:var(--ac);color:var(--ink);padding:0 8px;border-radius:8px}
.sub{color:var(--mu);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:22px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:.7s}.rv.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.btns{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px}
.btn{background:var(--ac);color:var(--ink);border:0;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:30px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.btn.o{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid #555;color:inherit}
/* intro */
#intro{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--bg);transition:transform 1s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)}
#intro.up{transform:translateY(-100%)}
.nm{display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px}
.nm svg{width:46px;height:46px;flex:none}
.nm path{fill:none;stroke:var(--ac);stroke-width:16;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:200;stroke-dashoffset:200;animation:d .9s ease forwards}
.nm path+path{animation-delay:.4s}
@keyframes d{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
#rest{max-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;transition:max-width 1.3s ease}
#rest.o{max-width:300px}
#intro p{margin-top:16px;color:var(--mu);opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s}#intro p.o{opacity:1}
/* nav */
nav{position:fixed;z-index:40;left:12px;right:12px;top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));max-width:616px;margin:auto;background:#000;border-radius:40px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 20px;font-size:12.5px}
nav a{color:#ddd;text-decoration:none}nav b{color:var(--ac);font-size:16px}
/* hero */
.hero{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:0 0 44px 44px;padding:96px 20px 40px;max-width:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero>div{max-width:600px;margin:auto}
.star{position:absolute;right:-30px;top:70px;width:110px;animation:rot 14s linear infinite;opacity:.9}
@keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.hero h1{font-size:35px;line-height:1.08;font-weight:800;max-width:300px}
.hero h1 mark{background:var(--ac);padding:0 8px;border-radius:10px}
.hero p{color:#555;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:14px;max-width:300px}
.me{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:22px}
.ph{position:relative;width:92px;height:92px;flex:none}
.ph img{width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 20%;margin:6px;position:relative}
.ph::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:3px dashed var(--ac);animation:rot 10s linear infinite}
.me b{display:block;font-size:17px}.me span{font-size:13px;color:#555}
.bd{margin-left:auto;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#555}.bd i{display:block;color:#f5b301;font-style:normal;letter-spacing:2px}.bd b{font-size:24px;color:var(--ink)}
.hero .btn.o{border-color:#bbb}
/* stats */
.st{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden}
.st div{padding:20px 8px;text-align:center;border:.5px solid #333}.st b{font-size:30px;color:var(--ac)}.st span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mu);margin-top:2px}
/* funnel */
.fn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.fn div{width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5fd21f,var(--ac));color:var(--ink);border-radius:16px;padding:13px 6px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.fn small{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:11px;white-space:normal}
.on .fn div:nth-child(1),.fn.on div:nth-child(1){width:100%}.fn.on div:nth-child(2){width:84%;transition-delay:.25s}.fn.on div:nth-child(3){width:68%;transition-delay:.5s}.fn.on div:nth-child(4){width:52%;transition-delay:.75s}
/* steps */
.sp{border-left:2px dashed #3a413d;margin-left:14px;padding-left:26px}
.sp div{position:relative;margin-bottom:22px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mu)}.sp b{display:block;color:var(--tx);font-size:16px}
.sp div::before{content:attr(data-n);position:absolute;left:-43px;top:0;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac);color:var(--ink);font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;transform:scale(0);transition:.5s .3s}
.sp.on div::before{transform:scale(1)}
/* venn */
.vn{width:100%;max-width:340px;display:block;margin:auto}
.vn circle,.vn text{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1)}
.vn.on circle,.vn.on text{transform:scale(1)}.vn.on circle+circle{transition-delay:.3s}.vn.on text{transition-delay:.7s}
/* camp types */
.ct{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.ct div{background:var(--bg2);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:.3s}.ct div:hover{background:var(--ac);color:var(--ink)}
.ct span{display:block;font-size:24px;margin-bottom:6px}
/* services */
.sv a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:1.5px solid #3a413d;border-radius:40px;padding:15px 20px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:15px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:.3s}
.sv a:hover{border-color:var(--ac);padding-left:28px}.sv a b{color:var(--ac)}.sv a i{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal}
.big{background:#000;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:22px 0;border-top:1px solid #333;border-bottom:1px solid #333}
.big div{display:inline-block;animation:mq 22s linear infinite;font:900 38px "Arial Black",Impact,sans-serif}.big u{text-decoration:none;color:var(--ac)}
.sm{padding:12px 0;background:var(--ac);color:var(--ink);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px}.sm div{font:800 14px Arial;animation-duration:30s}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.chips span{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid #333;border-radius:20px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px}
.tl{border-left:3px solid var(--ac);padding-left:18px}.tl div{margin-bottom:16px;position:relative;font-size:14px}.tl div::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-26px;top:3px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac)}.tl b{color:var(--ac);display:block}
.ft{background:var(--ac);color:var(--ink);border-radius:36px 36px 0 0;padding:36px 22px 90px;max-width:none}
.ft>div{max-width:600px;margin:auto}.ft h2{font-size:30px}.ft h2 em{background:var(--ink);color:var(--ac)}
.ft .btn{background:var(--ink);color:var(--ac)}.ft .btn.o{background:transparent;border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
/* chat */
#fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:50;width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--ink);color:var(--ac);font-size:26px;border:2px solid var(--ac);animation:pl 2s infinite;cursor:pointer}
@keyframes pl{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(141,255,63,.6)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(141,255,63,0)}}
/* chat */
#fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:50;width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--ac);color:#fff;font-size:26px;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(227,74,51,.7);animation:pl 2s infinite;cursor:pointer}
@keyframes pl{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(227,74,51,0)}}
#chat{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;background:var(--bg);display:none;flex-direction:column;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
#chat.open{display:flex;animation:f .3s forwards}
#ch{padding:14px 16px;background:var(--ac);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-weight:700}
#ch button{background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:24px}
#msgs{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.m{max-width:85%;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:16px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.45;white-space:pre-wrap}
.m.a{background:var(--bg2);align-self:flex-start;border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
.m.u{background:var(--ac);align-self:flex-end;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
#in{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:12px;padding-bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--bg2)}
#in input{flex:1;border:0;border-radius:24px;padding:13px 16px;font-size:16px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);outline:none}
#in button{border:0;background:var(--ac);color:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:0 18px;font-weight:700}
.qs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:0 16px 8px}.qs button{background:transparent;color:var(--tx);border:1px solid var(--ac);border-radius:16px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:12.5px}

#ch,#ch button,.m.u,#in button{color:var(--ink)!important}#ch button{background:none}
.m.a{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--tx)}#fab{animation:pl 2s infinite}
</style></head><body>
<div id="intro"><div class="nm"><svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><path d="M15 15 L85 85"/><path d="M85 15 L15 85"/></svg><span id="rest">asanov Sardor</span></div><p id="ip">Rezyumesiga xush kelibsiz</p></div>

<script>
const PH="";$('#pi')&&0;
function $(s){return document.querySelector(s)}
$('#pi').src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"+PH;
$('#sg').innerHTML=Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>`<line x1="50" y1="12" x2="50" y2="38" transform="rotate(${i*30} 50 50)"/>`).join("");
const BIO=`Siz Xasanov Sardorning (tug'ilgan 1995-yil 17-may, Toshkent) shaxsiy AI yordamchisisiz. Mijozlarga faqat Sardor haqida o'zbek tilida, qisqa va do'stona javob bering. Sardorning asosiy kuchi: Facebook Ads targetologi (2022-yildan): Lead Form va veb-sayt reklamasi, Reach, Xabarlar (messages), Retargeting, reklama auditoriyalarini yaratish va boshqarish. Unikal jihati: reklama kreativini (foto, video, montaj) ham o'zi tayyorlaydi — 2009-yildan foto/video sohasida (Glow Star Professional Studioda shogird bo'lib boshlagan). Boshqa xizmatlar: fotograf, foto-dizayner (Photoshop), videograf, montaj (Premiere Pro, After Effects), mobilograf (VN, CapCut), Uzum Market kartochka dizayni va mahsulot suratlari, AI vositalari (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Suno, Kling). Kurslar: SMM/Target (Space Academic 2022), Mobilografiya (DIG Professional 2022), Kodir School 2023, Mahmud Kamarov 2025. Hamkorlar: May Way, Black Star Cash, Vizir Kids, Edustudy Center, Good Catering, Habbatus Sauda Premium, Insperia-S Hotel, Media Park, Atlas Family Restaurant va boshqalar. Aloqa: +998 95 047-40-44, xasanovsardor111@gmail.com. Narx, muddat, natija va'dalari yoki buyurtma tafsilotlarini o'ylab topmang — Sardorga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'lanishni tavsiya qiling. Bilmagan narsangizni ham shunday deng.`;
const msgs=$('#msgs');let hist=[],cnt=0,busy=false,sample=null;
$('#mq').innerHTML=Array(2).fill("MAY WAY ✦ BLACK STAR CASH ✦ VIZIR KIDS ✦ EDUSTUDY CENTER ✦ GOOD CATERING ✦ HABBATUS SAUDA ✦ INSPERIA-S HOTEL ✦ MEDIA PARK ✦ ATLAS FAMILY ✦ PIXEL ✦ ").join("");
setTimeout(()=>$('#rest').classList.add('o'),1400);setTimeout(()=>$('#ip').classList.add('o'),2400);
setTimeout(()=>{$('#intro').classList.add('up');setTimeout(()=>$('#intro').remove(),1100)},3800);
const io=new IntersectionObserver(e=>e.forEach(x=>{if(x.isIntersecting){x.target.classList.add('on');io.unobserve(x.target);
x.target.querySelectorAll('[data-n]').forEach(c=>{const n=+c.dataset.n;let i=0;const iv=setInterval(()=>{c.textContent=++i;if(i>=n)clearInterval(iv)},70)})}}),{threshold:.2});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(e=>io.observe(e));
// chat
function add(t,c){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='m '+c;d.textContent=t;msgs.appendChild(d);msgs.scrollTop=1e9;return d}
function contact(){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='m a';d.innerHTML='Batafsil gaplashish uchun Sardorga to\'g\'ridan-to\'g\'ri bog\'laning:<div class="btns"><a class="btn" href="tel:+998950474044">📞 Qo\'ng\'iroq</a><a class="btn o" href="mailto:xasanovsardor111@gmail.com">✉️ Email</a></div>';msgs.appendChild(d);msgs.scrollTop=1e9}
function openChat(){$('#chat').classList.add('open');if(!msgs.children.length){add("Salom! 👋 Men Sardorning AI yordamchisiman. Uning xizmatlari va tajribasi haqida so'rang.","a");
$('#qs').innerHTML=["Qanday xizmatlar bor?","Tajribasi qancha?","Reklama qila oladimi?"].map(q=>`<button onclick="ask('${q}')">${q}</button>`).join("")}}
function closeChat(){$('#chat').classList.remove('open')}
function ask(t){$('#q').value=t;send()}
async function send(){const t=$('#q').value.trim();if(!t||busy)return;$('#q').value='';$('#qs').innerHTML='';add(t,'u');
if(cnt>=5){contact();return}
busy=true;cnt++;const b=add("…","a");
try{sample=sample||await claude.use("sample");if(!sample)throw{code:'none'};
const turns=[...hist,{role:"user",content:t}];
if(turns.length===1)turns[0].content=BIO+"\n\nMijoz savoli: "+t;else turns[0].content=BIO+"\n\nMijoz savoli: "+turns[0].content.split("Mijoz savoli: ").pop();
const r=await sample(turns,{cache:false,modelTier:"quick",onText:x=>{b.textContent=x.text;msgs.scrollTop=1e9}});
b.textContent=r.text;hist=[...hist,{role:"user",content:turns.at(-1).content},{role:"assistant",content:r.text}];
if(cnt>=4)contact()}
catch(e){b.textContent="Kechirasiz, hozir javob bera olmayman. Iltimos, Sardorga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'laning.";contact()}
busy=false}

</script></body></html>
